QuestInfo.name: [Lunar New Year Mission] Deliver Neinheart's Message
QuestInfo.0: Talk to Neinheart again to get the finished message.
QuestInfo.1: Neinheart's message is for his little sister, #bLilin#k. Take a boat out of Lith Harbor in Victoria Island to visit Lilin in #bRien#k.
QuestInfo.2: You delivered Neinheart's message to #bLilin#k, but she seems more concerned about Aran than her brother. What's that about?

default.0: Lilin is still in #bRien#k. Take a boat out of Lith Harbor in Victoria Island to visit her.
